description: Fills the frame with an image or clip and drops the speaker into a small rounded window in a corner. The window shows the speaker region of the footage - set once for the project, or overridden here - scaled down, so it frames the person rather than whatever happened to be in that corner.

fields.name: asset
fields.label: Full-frame image
fields.description: Image that fills the frame behind the speaker window.

fields.name: clip
fields.label: Full-frame clip
fields.description: Optional video; takes priority over the image.

fields.name: region
fields.label: Speaker region (overrides the project's)
fields.description: Drag the part of the source frame the window should show. Leave it unset to follow the project's speaker region.

fields.name: corner
fields.label: Speaker corner
fields.description: Which corner the speaker window sits in.

fields.name: size
fields.label: Window size
fields.description: Speaker window width as a fraction of the frame.

fields.name: entrance
fields.label: Entrance
fields.description: How the window arrives and leaves. 'lid' opens it from its hinged edge the way a laptop opens, and closes it the same way.

fields.name: effects
fields.label: Around the window
fields.description: Decoration around the window as it lands. 'glow' breathes a soft halo, 'ring' sends one expanding ring out from the edge.

fields.name: volume
fields.label: Clip volume
fields.description: Volume of the full-frame clip's own audio, 0 to 1.
